pieces.Text: A creature bitten by a sinspawn is overwhelmed with sinful thoughts (DC

Will save negates).  These emotions are so powerful that the target becomes sickened for 1d6 minutes.  An effected target that is bitten a second time is staggered for 1 round if it fails its saving throw.  Calm emotions, remove curse, or break enchantment negates the effects of sinful bite.
